ntpd_config_path.description: Path to the main NTP daemon configuration file.

listen_addresses.description: List of IP addresses the NTP daemon will listen on for incoming NTP requests.

allowed_networks.description: List of allowed client networks/hosts with optional netmask. Each entry must contain 'address' (IPv4/IPv6) and 'mask' (CIDR prefix length).

servers.description: List of upstream NTP servers to synchronize with. Each server entry includes hostname and optional iburst flag.

fallback_to_local_clock.description: Enable fallback to local clock if all external servers are unreachable.

allow_local_clock.description: Allow this host to act as an NTP server even when using local clock as fallback.

step_first.description: Step clock immediately on large initial offset instead of slewing.

step_first_threshold.description: Maximum offset (in seconds) to trigger immediate clock stepping.
